abstract: Adding tasks to my queue to review the new archives from Progressor I (#13) and Nova I (#14).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=26,
    description="Review Progressor I's Archive #13: 'Cultural Transmission...'",
    tick=153
)
aos_manager.create_task(
    parent_id=26,
    description="Review Nova I's Archive #14: '...Transmission-Integrated Metrics'",
    tick=153
)
